name: Matsumaru Serika
source:
Serika, an ally to Carol and Tsunuga, is a city girl proficient in information gathering. Blessed with a brilliant mind, she is sociable and frequently wears a smile.

Although tough enough to navigate the challenges of a criminal city, the reasons behind her choice to stay in such a dangerous place remain a mystery.

[Edited from [url=https://www.mangagamer.com/r18/detail.php?goods_type=1&product_code=1144#characters]MangaGamer[/url]]
